Collaborator limits are proposed and count people invited to an app, excluding its owner. They are not limits on the people using your finished app. Shared workspaces and collaboration require Pro; workspace membership is separate from the per-app collaborator limit. Building by collaborators uses the app owner’s credits. A source download includes code, not app users or business data; version restore changes code, not data. Custom domains are planned and are not available in the current early-access interface. Domain registration will be purchased separately.

One credit value. Every plan.

100 credits = $1 of Atomic usage. Credits pay for building and running your apps at Atomic’s usage rates. The same work uses the same credits on every plan; charges can be fractional, based on the resources used. For example, 15 credits means $0.15 of Atomic usage. A credit is not a message or a completed app.

A FEW PRACTICAL DETAILS

Before you choose.

Can I subscribe today?

Not yet. These are proposed launch plans. The early-access form adds you to the waitlist; it does not create an account, reserve a price, or start a subscription.

What is included in the subscription?

Builder includes 900 monthly credits, up to 5 apps and 2 published apps for $9/month, for building on your own. Pro includes 3,000 monthly credits, up to 50 apps and 20 published apps for $25/month, with team collaboration: shared workspaces and unlimited invited collaborators with Editor and Admin roles, building with the app owner’s credits. Custom domains are planned for Pro. Both include a backend, database, user authentication, private projects, source downloads and searchable logs under the proposed offer. Your subscription pays for the platform as well as the included usage.

How does Free work?

The proposed Free plan gives you 250 credits once; they do not renew each month. Build on your own and publish one app on an Atomic subdomain, with a small “Made with Atomic” badge. Every app can have a backend, database, and user sign-in. You can browse your apps’ source; downloading it, searchable logs, removing the badge and credit purchases require Builder or Pro; collaboration and custom domains require Pro. When all 250 are used, upgrade to keep building.

Do unused credits expire?

Unused monthly credits carry over into the next month, then expire; the oldest are always used first. Bought top-up credits last 12 months from purchase and are used after your monthly credits. Carried-over credits end if you move back to Free. Free’s 250 credits are given once and do not renew.

Is hosting included?

Your included credits can pay for metered hosting and persistent storage. Hosting is not unlimited, and storage can still cost credits when an app is stopped. We plan to let you protect part of your balance for hosting. Storage, bandwidth, concurrency limits, and hosting exhaustion and retention rules will be published before billing opens.

What happens when my credits run out?

There are no automatic overage charges. New builds require enough available credits. On Free, upgrade once all 250 are used. On Builder and Pro, you can buy 1,000 more credits for $10 or wait for your monthly allowance to renew. Hosting suspension, restart, retention and warning arrangements will be stated in the final offer before billing opens. The planned hosting-budget control will let you set aside credits that building cannot spend.

Will there be annual billing?

The launch proposal is monthly billing only. Annual plans and discounts have not been announced.

What happens if I cancel?

Cancellation, data retention, export access, and the behavior of published apps will be specified in the final subscription terms before checkout becomes available.
